capabilities: Check grammar, spelling and fluency in the active note
Highlight suggestions inline with suggestion cards
Explain why a change is suggested
Show connection state and suggestion count in the status bar
extras: Needs macOS 14+, Obsidian desktop 1.5.0+ and Refine for Mac 1.35+; basic grammar checks are free, other features need a one-time license ($38 for 1 Mac, $68 for 3 Macs) after a 7-day trial. Only the active note in Editing view is checked, not the whole vault or Reading view.
intentEvidence: Is Refine a private Grammarly alternative for Obsidian?
problem: Obsidian offers no contextual grammar, spelling and fluency review, and cloud checkers require sending note text to an outside service.

relations.evidence: Is Refine a private Grammarly alternative for Obsidian?
The plugin sends the complete active Markdown note to the Refine app over a same-user Unix socket

summary: Offline AI grammar, spelling and fluency checker for Obsidian on macOS that works through a companion Mac app running a local language model.
